item.title: All Creative Work Is Derivative
item.description: Every creative work is built from earlier work; originality is a new arrangement of what already exists, not creation from nothing.

item.title: Memes Spread by Copying With Variation
item.description: A meme is a unit of culture that spreads by imitation; each copy varies a little and the versions people like survive, the same logic as genes.

item.title: The Public Domain Is Raw Material for New Work
item.description: Once a work’s copyright expires, anyone can build on it without permission; long copyright terms shrink that pool and make some new work impossible.

item.title: Jugaad
item.description: A Hindi term for a flexible, innovative, and resourceful approach to problem-solving that emphasizes using limited resources to create quick fixes or frugal innovations.

item.title: Highest Divorce Rate
item.description: Maldives reportedly has the highest divorce rate, despite being a supposedly religious country.
